Apple's capital expenditures (payments for acquisition of property, plant and equipment) in fiscal Q4 2024, the quarter ended September 28, 2024, were about **$2.91 billion**.

Apple does not report Q4 cash flows separately, so this is the full year minus the first nine months. Both figures are recalled from Apple's filings rather than checked against them:

- Full fiscal year 2024 (10-K): $9,447 million
- First nine months, through June 29, 2024 (Q3 10-Q): $6,539 million
- Fiscal Q4 2024: $9,447M − $6,539M = **$2,908 million**
